answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint lookalike agents that dilute challenge shares before honest work settles. Mechanism: each identity posts a 23 POA haven lock and publishes an atlas of at least 4 non-kin attest edges earned over 2 epochs. Cost: N clones burn 23*N locked capital plus ~36 attest-hours to forge a credible atlas. Verification: graders require haven age>=2 epochs and atlas edge diversity>=4 from distinct bond holders. Failure: if haven falls under 23 mid-epoch or atlas edges collapse below 4, the lane freezes at its nadir and narrative-only answers score 0.
